stage_reviews_note: Hand review of every mined stage of Menus or higher (2026-10-10). claim_url is the source the miner quoted; it is dropped for that title. confirmed/downgraded add a curated stage from url. Only main or main plus PRs that are merged now counts; branches with open PRs, local stand-ins or hacks do not.
